name: mcp-atlassian-new
description: Connect Jira and Confluence to AI assistants via the Model Context Protocol
long_description: Bridges Atlassian's Jira and Confluence with AI assistants that support MCP. Search, read, and (unless read-only mode is enabled) create and update issues, pages, and comments across both Cloud and Server/Data Center deployments using API token, personal access token, or OAuth 2.0 authentication.

jira_url.title: Jira URL
jira_url.description: Your Jira instance URL, e.g. https://your-company.atlassian.net (Cloud) or https://jira.your-domain.com (Server/DC)

jira_username.title: Jira Username
jira_username.description: Your Atlassian account email (Cloud) or Server/DC username

jira_api_token.title: Jira API Token
jira_api_token.description: API token from https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens (Cloud), or your password for Server/DC basic auth

confluence_url.title: Confluence URL
confluence_url.description: Your Confluence instance URL, e.g. https://your-company.atlassian.net/wiki (Cloud) or https://confluence.your-domain.com (Server/DC)

confluence_username.title: Confluence Username
confluence_username.description: Your Atlassian account email (Cloud) or Server/DC username

confluence_api_token.title: Confluence API Token
confluence_api_token.description: API token from https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens (Cloud), or your password for Server/DC basic auth
